newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Moody's assigns Aa1 rating to TCNZ Finance bonds.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Aa1 rating to TCNZ Finance bonds.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it has assigned its Aa1 long-term debt rating to the 150 million Swiss franc bonds issued by TCNZ Finance Ltd.
The bonds benefit from a direct guarantee from Telecom Corporation of New Zealand Ltd and its material subsidiaries.
The rating also reflected the senior unsecured status of the bonds which would rank pari passu with all existing senior unsecured obligations of TCNZ Finance Ltd and the guarantor, Moody's said.

Moody's said the rating was also based on the expectation that Telecom's improved cost structure and modern network would provide the company with sufficient flexibility to price and market its telecommunications services competitively, maintaining its leading market position in a competitive and maturing market.

"As a result, Telecom's strong and stable cash generation chracteristics will permit a gradual improvement in leverage and debt protection measurements which are being impaired by the commencement of its share buy back programme," Moody's said.
